services.desc: The Hoffmann Family of Companies (HF Companies), a US-based family-owned private equity firm, announced today the acquisition of Sip n’ Sail Cruises, a Mackinac Island-based company known for its diverse range of cruises and private charter options around the island. blurb: Shepler’s new 2026 Sunset Cruise offers a serene and scenic way to end the day, sailing through the Straits of Mackinac during the golden hour as the sky glows with vibrant colors over Lakes Huron and Michigan. Passengers glide beneath the Mackinac Bridge, circle the shores of Mackinac Island, and enjoy peaceful twilight views accompanied by gentle breezes and panoramic horizons.
